newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican newspaper criticises condom handouts.
newsitem.headline: Vatican newspaper criticises condom handouts.

text.p: The Vatican's semi-official newspaper on Monday criticised organisers of World AIDS Day events in Italy for handing out condoms.
L'Osservatore Romano said they had transformed World AIDS Day on Sunday "into a series of vulgar appeals for the use of condoms".

Pope John Paul is firmly opposed to the use of condoms to guard against AIDS. He has said the disease is spread by irresponsible sexual behaviour and that chastity is the only means acceptable to the Church to fight the epidemic.
